name: Typing Tyrani
author: ytcraftLearn2021
description: You are just a poor commoner who lives on a tyrant queen's kingdom. She is famous for giving a quest to one of her 'lucky' citizen every other days. You lived nonchalantly as that doesn't matter to you. But alas, luck was not on your side today and you just struck by a super bad luck, YOU HAVE TO GO ON A TYPING TRIAL!! Now, its time to fight the tyrant and win this! Who will be the last to laugh, you...or her.
